incident.summary: Internal record of the sudden disappearance of about half of all life and the later return of the missing population. The file tracks governance, logistics, and security effects rather than a single battlefield.
observations: The disappearance was simultaneous and did not follow a conventional attack pattern.
The return created secondary crises in housing, identity, and airspace control.
No conventional perpetrator was available for detention when the event began.
incident.conclusion: The Blip is approved for internal circulation. It is not cleared for public release under the declassified tier.
